answer: A payoff letter isn't strictly required: we confirm what is owed at the appointment and pay the lender off directly from our offer, but getting a payoff letter beforehand speeds things up. If the lender is in our e-payoff network, you don't need a letter at all, but the help center doesn't say whether Lakeshore Bank is in that network, so please contact a store to check. Because you inherited the car, you'll also need his death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator, or the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) for a small estate. If there are several heirs, either the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1, and a power of attorney he signed can't be used because it ended when he died.
